snippet.title: Corner Driver - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
When you play Corner Driver you have the intense Pacman-like experience but also the fear of avoiding police cars, as getting caught by them will diminish your chances.

Corner Driver is a very intense, fun game and also a casual one with creative gameplay ideas.

Developed by Gametry sp. z.o.o.
Also released on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch
